post.title: Does paying rent build credit? Only if someone reports it
post.ig:
You pay rent every month. Your credit score probably never sees it.

In a 2025 TransUnion survey, just 13% of renters said their rent was reported to credit bureaus.
Rent isn't reported by default: a landlord or a third-party service (some paid) has to send it.
FICO 9 and VantageScore 4.0 count reported rent; FICO 8, the version lenders use most, generally doesn't (Experian Boost is an exception).
Since September 2026, all approved Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac lenders can use VantageScore 4.0.

Sources: TransUnion Rent Payment Reporting 2025; Experian; myFICO; FHFA; Fannie Mae LL-2026-06.
